candidates.summary: ADR says user content cannot produce a button because the sanitizer escapes it, but that escape lives in the deployed chain/markdown native and the renderer ships in gnoweb on its own deploy; the ADR names neither the chain-upgrade dependency nor that the EscapeBlockHazards(Rich) output change is consensus-affecting
candidates.failure_scenario: gnoweb built from 065ec369b serves a chain still on the chain/mainnet native (0 `gno-button` hits there; base isExtDelimiter escapes only a line-start `<gno-`). A commondao bylaws document rendered through sanitize.Block (chain/mainnet render.gno:441) or a boards2 infoAlert through md.Blockquote that carries `Vote: <gno-button href="/r/x" label="Approve" />` mid-line or in a list item reaches gnoweb unescaped and renders as a first-party styled call-to-action until the chain upgrades. Separately, a tx-time caller that stores Block output gets different bytes after the upgrade; every in-tree mainnet caller runs at Render time, so no stored output in the tree shifts.
